findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_domain_check, threat_scanners, legal_sanctions_screen, trade_party_screen, url_check, url_safety, domain_dns_hygiene, security_domain_threat_report · Private data: ai_chat, threat_scanners, crypto_token_report, legal_reg_watch, dns_lookup, crypto_balance · Public sink: email_domain_check, ai_chat, domain_due_diligence, finance_insider_activity, business_vet, text_summarize, email_sender_trust, domain_dns_hygiene, security_phishing_triage, health_drug_safety_compare, security_domain_threat_report, security_inbound_request_screen · Destructive: threat_ip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_domain_check, threat_scanners, legal_sanctions_screen, trade_party_screen, url_check, url_safety, domain_dns_hygiene, security_domain_threat_report · Private data: ai_chat, threat_scanners, crypto_token_report, legal_reg_watch, dns_lookup, crypto_balance · Public sink: email_domain_check, ai_chat, domain_due_diligence, finance_insider_activity, business_vet, text_summarize, email_sender_trust, domain_dns_hygiene, security_phishing_triage, health_drug_safety_compare, security_domain_threat_report, security_inbound_request_screen · Destructive: threat_ip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
